findings.candidate_quote: The study observed associations between LPD, FGF21, and gut microbiota but did not establish causality or clinical outcomes.
findings.reference_quote: To test this, 5/6 Nx CKD mice were administered oral LpWJL (3.108 CFU) or vehicle, five times per week for six weeks, under either a standard diet or LPD (Figure 5a, Table S1).
findings.explanation: The blanket denial of causality obscures controlled animal interventions and the randomized dietary trial, which support causal treatment effects on measured outcomes. FGF21 mediation remains unproven, and human probiotic efficacy was not tested; those narrower uncertainties do not make the entire study associational.
